title: Changes at Google DeepMind: Demis Hassabis from CEO to Chair, Jeff Dean departs
titleZh: 谷歌 DeepMind 人事变动：Demis Hassabis 从首席执行官转为董事长，Jeff Dean 离职
author: colesantiago
relevanceReason: 命中 3 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: Editor’s note: Today, Google and Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai shared some changes with Google DeepMind teams, including new roles for Demis Hassabis and Koray Kavukcuoglu. Below are the messages Sundar and Demis sent to employees.

Message from Sundar PichaiWe’ve made extraordinary progress to deliver on our full AI stack. We’ve got amazing talent, world-class compute, and products that bring AI to more people than any other company. And you saw the incredible momentum at earnings across all our businesses, including Search, YouTube, and Cloud. Our Gemini models are in high demand among developers and businesses, and the Gemini app reached 950M+ monthly users. Meanwhile, our AI research continues to drive field-defining breakthroughs (like last week’s Gemini Robotics advances).We have to accelerate all this work and stay focused on the AI frontier. At the same time, there’s never been a more important moment to shape the future of AGI and science. Today Demis, Koray and I are sharing a few changes to our Google DeepMind teams that will enable us to do both.AGI and science: Demis has described us as standing in the foothills of the singularity, and has been spending a lot of his time engaging externally. He and I have been long discussing a role that allows him to put his full attention on actively shaping the future of AGI. It’s work that is vitally important to Alphabet and humanity, and I can’t imagine a better person than Demis to do it. So, moving forward, Demis will become the Chair of GDM and Chief Scientist of Alphabet, while continuing to lead Isomorphic Labs. He’ll remain closely connected to Koray, Josh, and our GDM teams, advising across models and research. I’m so excited for Demis — this is truly his life’s work and purpose. You can read Demis’s note to GDM below.Google DeepMind: We are building strong momentum: Flash is in high demand, our Cyber model is live, and Gemma models have surpassed 900M+ downloads. We are committed to being at the frontier, and are super focused on the areas where we need to improve. I’m really excited for our upcoming model releases and the progress we’re seeing. We have to continue to move fast and with clear purpose here. Koray, the current Chief Technology Officer of GDM and our Chief AI Architect, will step up as SVP of Google DeepMind, reporting to me. He will oversee Gemini model development, Frontier AI research, and the Gemini app and developer teams. Koray has been at DeepMind since its early days, and over his 13 years there, he has started our deep learning team and led the way on breakthroughs like WaveNet and DQN. I look forward to seeing him lead GDM into this next chapter.Lastly, after an incredible 27-year run, Jeff Dean is at a moment where he wants to try something new, and we’re excited to support him in that. Jeff and Google Senior Fellow Sanjay Ghemawat are launching an independent public benefit corporation to accelerate discoveries in ML, science, and engineering. Jeff and Sanjay helped to drive some of the most significant technology transitions, from our early search infrastructure to the neural networks that helped create the modern AI era. On a personal note, it’s been a privilege to work alongside Jeff and Sanjay, and I wish them all the best! We’ll continue to work with them as a founding investor and Cloud partner, and collaborate on a research framework for ML systems and related infrastructure advances.We are at a dynamic moment with so much opportunity ahead. With today's changes we're going to keep driving our momentum. Onwards!-Sundar

Message from Demis HassabisHi TeamWe have arrived at a pivotal moment in human history. I’ve been working towards AGI my whole life and now, like many of you, I feel it is close at hand. It’s critical that we collectively get the next steps right to ensure this all goes well for humanity and we usher in an incredible new age of discovery and wonder.With this backdrop, I’ve decided that now is the right time for me to hand over my day-to-day operational responsibilities at GDM, so that I have the time and space to focus on the big picture and help influence what is to come to the best of my ability. I will be taking on a new strategic role as Chair of GDM and Chief Scientist of Alphabet, and I’m excited to announce that Koray will be stepping up to lead GDM as SVP of Google DeepMind, in addition to his role as Chief AI Architect of Google.Koray and I have been working together for over 13 years, since the early days of DeepMind. He is one of the world's foremost AI experts and has been championing GDM's mission from day one. I have total confidence in Koray, Josh, and the rest of the GDM exec team as they continue to spearhead the latest AI developments across Google. The Gemini models are in good hands with Koray and the leads, as they have been for a while, and I'm excited about the great progress we’re making with our new models including Gemini 4.In my new role, I will continue to work closely with Sundar on strategic and global AGI matters, and to advise Koray, Josh, and the GDM leads, from our awesome new London Platform 37 offices. As part of this transition, I’ll also be leaning into my role at Isomorphic, where we are making extremely rapid and promising progress, to accelerate our mission there even faster. As you've heard me say many times, I’ve always believed the No.1 application of AI should be to improve human health. It’s time for AI to prove its unequivocal value to the world, and what better way to demonstrate that than to help finally cure diseases like cancer.We’ve built a unique culture at GDM that has served us very well. I want to thank each and every one of you for your brilliance, dedication, and effort that make GDM the huge success it is today. We should all be extremely proud of the amazing things we’ve achieved so far. We’ve become the AI engine room of Google, with Gemini delivering helpful experiences everywhere including AI Mode and AI Overviews, the Gemini App rocketing to over 950M monthly users, and our fundamental and scientific research continues to lead the world. I’m very excited for our next chapter and the best is yet to come!As a business we are in an incredibly strong position. We are the only company that has the full stack and we’re world-class at every layer from infrastructure to cloud to frontier models to AI-first applications. We have all the ingredients to lead from here, and I firmly believe we will.BestDemis

comments.author: GodelNumbering
comments.textRawHtml:
So, in last several months, all the prominent names Google lost: Demis Hassabis (technically still with google but these things are usually presented with a spin), Jeff Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals, Quoc Le, Noam Shazeer, John Jumper, Jonas Adler, Alexander Pritzel, David Silver, Denny Zhou, Fernando Pereira, Alex Turner

And all the prominent names Google gained: NULL

Combined with no gemini frontier GA release in about 14 months. You have to have created an environment pretty hostile to innovation for this to happen
comments.textZhHtml:
因此，在过去的几个月里，Google 失去了所有知名人士：Demis Hassabis（技术上仍属于 Google，但这些东西通常会以旋转形式呈现）、Jeff Dean、Sanjay Ghemawat、Oriol Vinyals、Quoc Le、Noam Shazeer、John Jumper、Jonas Adler、Alexander Pritzel、David Silver、Denny Zhou、Fernando Pereira、Alex Turner

以及所有知名人士Google 获得：NULL

加上大约 14 个月内没有 Gemini Frontier GA 发布。为了实现这一点，你必须创造一个对创新非常敌视的环境

children.author: hintymad
children.textRawHtml: This funny post reads surreal, but it may carry some truth: https://x.com/signulll/status/2067446889956430273?lang=en
children.textZhHtml: 这篇有趣的文章读起来超现实，但它可能包含一些真相：https://x.com/signulll/status/2067446889956430273?lang=en

children.author: ChuckMcM
children.textRawHtml: In my opinion it carries much truth. Somewhere in Google's archives there is a message I sent to the OC that said, "The department of philosophy does not ship solutions to real problems, that is why there has never been a successful company that insisted the world adapt to its philosophy." Google was, even then, blind to what they were missing.
children.textZhHtml: 在我看来，它有很多道理。在谷歌的档案中，有一条我发给 OC 的消息，上面写着：“哲学部门并不提供真正问题的解决方案，这就是为什么从来没有一家成功的公司坚持让世界适应其哲学。”即使在那时，谷歌也对他们所遗漏的东西视而不见。

children.author: yyaakkqq
children.textRawHtml: I wish their deep tech teams moved as fast as the privacy violating ones.
children.textZhHtml: 我希望他们的深度技术团队能够像侵犯隐私的团队一样快速行动。

children.author: breppp
children.textRawHtml: If it's any solace the privacy violating ones are also slow
children.textZhHtml: 如果有什么安慰的话，侵犯隐私的速度也很慢

children.author: wasting_time
children.textRawHtml:
Off-topic, but clicking this link instantly crashes my desktop in both Firefox and Chromium. Debian 13 with backports kernel, AMD laptop graphics.

I have never seen anything like it in 20 years of Linux desktop use.
children.textZhHtml:
偏离主题，但单击此链接会立即使我的 Firefox 和 Chromium 桌面崩溃。带有向后移植内核的 Debian 13、AMD 笔记本电脑显卡。

在 20 年的 Linux 桌面使用中，我从未见过类似的东西。

children.author: adrian_b
children.textRawHtml:
Firefox and Vivaldi browsers on Gentoo, NVIDIA GPU, both work normally with that link.

So it must be something very specific to what software you have installed, unless it is an AMD GPU problem, but neither of the 2 links (x and xcancel) has anything that seems to need special GPU features.

It certainly is not a general Linux problem. I also use XFCE as desktop, so if you use Gnome it could be some Gnome component.
children.textZhHtml:
Gentoo、NVIDIA GPU 上的 Firefox 和 Vivaldi 浏览器都可以正常使用该链接。

因此，它必须与您安装的软件非常特定，除非它是 AMD GPU 问题，但这 2 个链接（x 和 xcancel）都没有任何似乎需要特殊 GPU 功能的东西。

这当然不是一般的 Linux 问题。我也使用 XFCE 作为桌面，所以如果你使用 Gnome，它可能是一些 Gnome 组件。

children.author: bjackman
children.textRawHtml: this prompted me to search and find: https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/xcancel/

children.author: spwa4
children.textRawHtml: Thank you. Twitter has become such a terrible website in the last years. Well, since Musk, really. Real disaster.
children.textZhHtml: 谢谢。在过去的几年里，Twitter 已经成为一个如此糟糕的网站。嗯，自从马斯克以来，真的。真正的灾难。

children.author: snthpy
children.textRawHtml: Yes, but now we have AI to summarize tweets.
children.textZhHtml: 是的，但现在我们有人工智能来总结推文。

children.author: adityazero
children.textRawHtml:
> sundar, softly: “we can create a permission working group.”

so true. i have attended meetings to decide on meeting topics for the next half.
children.textZhHtml:
> sundar，轻声说道：“我们可以创建一个权限工作组。”

确实如此。我参加了会议，决定下半年的会议主题。

children.author: Bendy
children.textRawHtml:
Reminded me of a bit from the GOAT political comedy Yes, Prime Minister:

"But he's the Prime Minister!"

"Indeed he is Bernard. He has his own car, a nice house in London, a place in the country, endless publicity and a pension for life. What more does he want?"

"I think he wants to govern Britain."

"Well stop him, Bernard!"
children.textZhHtml:
让我想起了 GOAT 政治喜剧《是的，首相》中的一段话：

“但他是首相！”

“他确实是伯纳德。他有自己的车，在伦敦有一栋漂亮的房子，在乡下有一处地方，无尽的宣传和终身养老金。他还想要什么？”

“我认为他想统治英国。”

“好吧他，伯纳德！”

children.author: titanomachy
children.textRawHtml:
Oh man, that show has some amazing writing.

"Tobacco-related diseases cost the NHS £150 million per year!"

"Yes we've looked into that, it turns out that if those people had survived they would have cost us billions in pensions and healthcare costs! From a financial perspective, it's vastly preferable that they continue to die at the current rate."
children.textZhHtml:
哦，天哪，那个节目的文笔很棒。

“烟草相关疾病每年给 NHS 造成 1.5 亿英镑的损失！”

“是的，我们已经调查过这一点，事实证明，如果这些人幸存下来，他们将花费我们数十亿的养老金和医疗费用！从财务角度来看，他们现在继续死去是非常可取的率。”

children.author: rob74
children.textRawHtml: This is indeed what the current US administration is failing at: keeping Trump from governing the US...
children.textZhHtml: 这确实是现任美国政府的失败之处：阻止特朗普治理美国......

children.author: galangalalgol
children.textRawHtml: I would not have chosen the word governing for that sentence but I'm not sure what fits best. Plundering, pillaging, gutting, ransacking, Rick rolling, despoilng, or perhaps molesting.
children.textZhHtml: 我不会选择用于该句子的词来管理，但我不确定什么最适合。掠夺、掠夺、掏空、洗劫、翻滚、掠夺，或者可能是骚扰。

children.author: SR2Z
children.textRawHtml: Sending ICE agents to chase around random children and demand they (on their own) provide proof of citizenship sure seems to fit the bill to me.
children.textZhHtml: 派遣 ICE 特工随机追捕儿童并要求他们（自行）提供公民身份证明似乎很适合我。

children.author: MyHonestOpinon
children.textRawHtml: "If you are famous they let you do anything!"
children.textZhHtml: “如果你出名，他们就会让你做任何事！”

children.textRawHtml: Trump is indeed effective at pillaging. The interesting thing is that Yuri explained and predicted (!) this in the 1980s: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yErKTVdETpw
children.textZhHtml: 特朗普在掠夺方面确实很有效。有趣的是，Yuri 在 20 世纪 80 年代解释并预测了这一点：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yErKTVdETpw
